summary: The eight-load cap counts successful loads, allowing unbounded failed git/filesystem attempts and fleet-gate timeout multiplication.
Non-UTF8 git blobs and recursion-depth JSON can raise out of check 62 instead of degrading to an unsearched WARN.
Sanitization tokens inside quoted sample content skip the whole line and create a direct fabricated-row false-PASS.
Tracked backtick paths and missing-SHA fallbacks search mutable working-copy bytes rather than the committed artifact named by the body.
Escaped quotes, tilde fences, and nested details can silently yield no stems and PASS fabricated samples.
Stems after the first 40 are silently omitted, allowing a fabricated 41st row to receive an unqualified PASS.
Any unsearchable Sample-slot candidate downgrades all local misses to WARN; critic and human follow-through must remain binding.
Spot-check #952’s four WARN-only stems against the linked HF artifacts; they are absent from the committed local bank.
Check-62 load cap counts successful loads only; failed load attempts and per-path existence probes are unbounded on pathological bodies
evidence: verify_task_body.py _load_verbatim_artifacts: cap tests len(loaded), failures never counted; _classify_slot_artifact_links runs one existence probe per is_file()-passing backtick path. Check-54 precedent memoizes ATTEMPTS incl. failures (verify_task_body.py:13887-13890). Measured: a failing object probe = ~15 ms (fast-fail, not the 10-30 s timeout ceiling), so magnitude = seconds on an absurd body, not fleet-wedging. Fix: count unique attempts toward the cap; overflow degrades to WARN notes.

summary: Two exception classes escape check-62 fail-soft loading: RecursionError on adversarially-deep JSON, and UnicodeDecodeError on a non-UTF8 blob via the reused text-mode loader
evidence: Round-added _load_artifact_views excepts (ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError) - RecursionError escapes json.loads on ~1000+-deep nesting. Reused _git_json_text_at_sha (verify_task_body.py:13648-13677, UNTOUCHED main code, also reachable via check 54) runs subprocess text=True with an (OSError, SubprocessError) catch - UnicodeDecodeError (a ValueError subclass) escapes; check 62 widens its reachability. Failure mode is a loud per-body crash, not a wrong verdict; 2569-body sweep clean. Fix: catch RecursionError at both decode sites; decode blob output with errors=replace at the source loader.
